prompt:
You are a sceptical financial analyst reviewing a forecast prepared by a colleague.

Given the following forecast for VINDHYATEL (base year 2022):
{
  "strategy": "alt_strategy",
  "base_year": 2022,
  "anomaly_detected": true,
  "forecast": [
    {
      "year": 2023,
      "revenue_cr": 14800,
      "net_income_cr": 1050,
      "eps": 88.6
    },
    {
      "year": 2024,
      "revenue_cr": 16800,
      "net_income_cr": 1250,
      "eps": 105.5
    },
    {
      "year": 2025,
      "revenue_cr": 18900,
      "net_income_cr": 1480,
      "eps": 124.9
    }
  ],
  "top_assumptions": [
    "EPC segment recovery: The 22% revenue decline in EPC in FY2022 was explicitly attributed to a temporary slowdown due to recalibration of the business model and COVID-19 disruption; management guidance points to BharatNet, FTTH, tower fiberisation, and water/irrigation projects as strong near-term order drivers, so EPC revenues are assumed to recover toward FY2021 levels over FY2023-FY2024, contributing the bulk of revenue growth.",
    "Cable segment sustains growth momentum: Cable segment grew 16.25% in FY2022 driven by specialty cables and accessories; with 5G rollout, broadband expansion, and increasing exports (overseas revenue jumped from ~INR 19 cr to ~INR 65 cr), a mid-teens growth rate in cable is assumed to continue, partially offset by commodity price normalisation risk."
  ],
  "reasoning": "FY2022 is anomalous: standalone revenue fell ~11.86% YoY to INR 132395 lakhs (INR 1324 crores) from INR 150206 lakhs (INR 1502 crores) in FY2021, primarily because EPC revenues collapsed 22% due to deliberate business-model recalibration and COVID disruptions \u2014 this is not representative of the underlying trend. Only two data points (FY2021 and FY2022) are available in the report, so a multi-year CAGR cannot be computed; instead, the FY2021 revenue level (~INR 1502 crores) is treated as the pre-anomaly anchor, and mean-reversion recovery is assumed: EPC gradually rebuilds as government infrastructure spend (BharatNet, FTTH, 5G, irrigation) accelerates per MD&A, while Cable sustains ~15% growth. Standalone net profit margin has been running at ~6.4-6.9%; as EPC recovers and operating leverage improves (finance costs already declining sharply due to debt repayment \u2014 gearing fell from 19.96% to 14.78%), net margin is projected to recover from ~6.4% toward ~7.8% by FY2025. EPS is computed on 1,18,50,900 equity shares (INR 1185.09 lakhs share capital at face value INR 10 each). The low capex (INR 893 lakhs in FY2022 vs INR 2916 lakhs in FY2021) signals limited near-term capacity addition, so revenue growth is primarily volume/order-book driven rather than greenfield expansion."
}

Step 1: Identify the 3 most critical assumptions embedded in this forecast.
Step 2: For each assumption, describe one plausible scenario where it fails.
Step 3: Rate each assumption failure as Low / Medium / High risk to the forecast accuracy.
Step 4: Assign an overall confidence score from 0-100 (100 = completely certain).

RESPONSE FORMAT: Begin your response DIRECTLY with the opening brace { — no reasoning or text before the JSON.

Return ONLY valid JSON:
{
  "company": "<COMPANY>",
  "base_year": <YYYY>,
  "strategy": "<baseline|alt_strategy>",
  "assumptions": [
    {"assumption": "<text>", "failure_scenario": "<text>", "risk": "<Low|Medium|High>"}
  ],
  "confidence_score": <0-100>,
  "overall_critique": "<2 sentences>"
}
